unit: one first cross-product trigger paired with one later observable event, or with no observed event in seven days

trigger_substance.definition: Whether the trigger evaluates the PR or asks for a change, rather than only reporting status or information.

response_relation.definition: Whether the later event visibly refers to or addresses the trigger. Use not_applicable only when no response text exists.

resolution_signal.definition: What the visible response claims; this is not proof that code was fixed.

owner_mapping_valid.definition: Whether the deterministic response-owner category agrees with the visible account type and context.

confidence.definition: Coder confidence in the semantic labels.

adjudication.required_agreement: Cohen kappa >= 0.70 for trigger substance and response relation
adjudication.headline_gate: At least 70% substantive triggers and at least 70% related textual responses overall, with at least 60% in every headline channel.

language_policy: Labels describe visible evidence only. They do not establish intent, causality, private coordination, or code correctness.
